newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: B.Leisure says holding firm ups stake.
newsitem.headline: B.Leisure says holding firm ups stake.

text.p: Malaysia's hotel and resort operator Berjaya Leisure Bhd said on Tuesday its holding company, Berjaya Group Bhd has bought nearly 12.6 million shares in the company this year.

In reply to a query from the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on the stock's recent sharp price increase and turnover jump, B.Leisure said companies related to Berjaya Group bought the shares in the open market between January 2 and January 27.
The share were bought at prices ranging from 3.79 ringgit to 5.47 ringgit.
B.Leisure stock ended Tuesday trading at 6.10 ringgit, up 40 cents on volume of 5.83 million.
It said the company was not aware of any other reason for the stock's "unusual" performance other than the share-buying activities.
The statement did not say the percentage of equity that Berjaya Group now holds in B.Leisure.
A January 3 statement by Berjaya Group said it has a 73.56 percent stake in B.Leisure.
